inlineSql: SELECT * FROM AD_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND SCHM_CODE = ' ? '

Select A.MEMB_CODE,B.MEMB_NAME,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_MOBILE,B.EMP_CODE,C.EMP_NAME,B.JOIN_DATE As JoinDt,B.MEMB_AMT As MembAmt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.OS_TYPE = 'A' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.GOLD_WT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) as SchmGold,SUM(CASE WHEN A.OS_TYPE = 'A' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) as SchmAmt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.OS_TYPE = 'D' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '-' THEN A.ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) as SchmAdj,SUM(CASE WHEN A.OS_TYPE = 'B' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '-' THEN A.ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) as BonusAmt FROM (AD_OS AS A LEFT JOIN AD_MEMB AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE AND A.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE) LEFT JOIN EMP_MAST AS C ON B.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND B.EMP_CODE = C.EMP_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND B.MEMB_AMT = ? AND B.EMP_CODE = ' ? ' ? and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND B.MEMB_CODE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY A.MEMB_CODE,B.MEMB_NAME,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_MOBILE,B.EMP_CODE,C.EMP_NAME,B.JOIN_DATE,B.MEMB_AMT ? HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.OS_TYPE = 'A' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN A.OS_TYPE = 'D' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '-' THEN A.ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) <= 0 ORDER BY A.MEMB_CODE
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
SELECT SCHM_NAME As SchmName,SCHM_CODE as Code FROM AD_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY SCHM_CODE
SELECT EMP_NAME As SchmName,EMP_CODE as Code FROM EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY EMP_CODE
SELECT CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,AC_NAME FROM SL_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '
SELECT CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,AC_NAME FROM PR_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '

Select Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) < 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As DrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) > 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As CrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrGold, Case When SUM(Case When A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrGold, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrSilver, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrSilver FROM (AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' ?

Select B.BOOK_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.LEDR_KEY,A.LD_CODE As AC_CODE,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_MOBILE,B.MAIN_BOOK,C.AC_AREA, Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) < 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As DrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) > 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As CrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrGold, Case When SUM(Case When A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrGold, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrSilver, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrSilver,B.MAIN_BOOK FROM (AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.LD_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY B.BOOK_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.LEDR_KEY,A.LD_CODE,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_MOBILE,B.MAIN_BOOK,C.AC_AREA ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,B.BOOK_NAME

SELECT B.MEMB_NAME FROM (AD_DATA AS A INNER JOIN ROJ_MEL_DATA AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = C.LC_CODE AND A.CO_YEAR = C.CO_YEAR AND A.CO_BOOK = C.CO_BOOK AND A.VCH_NO = C.VCH_NO) INNER JOIN AD_MEMB AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE AND A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? CO_BOOK ? ' AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? VCH_NO ? ' AND A.SR_NO = ?

Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_GR IN ( '02','03','19','21','22','23') AND CAST(A.AC_CODE AS INT) >=200 ORDER BY C.AC_NAME

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_GR IN ( '02','03','19','21','22','23') AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.AC_NAME
SELECT BOOK_NAME ,CO_BOOK ,BOOK_TYPE,ITM_TYPE,MAIN_BOOK,BOOK_SNAME,BOOK_INOUT,MENU_NAME FROM BOOK_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? '

SELECT Sum(CR_AMT - DR_AMT) as BalAmt FROM AC_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' and VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? HAVING SUM(CR_AMT-DR_AMT) <> 0

SELECT Sum(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN (CASE WHEN OS_TYPE = 'A' THEN ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) as SchmAmt, Sum(CASE WHEN SIGN = '-' THEN (CASE WHEN OS_TYPE = 'D' THEN ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) As AdjAmt , Sum(CASE WHEN SIGN = '-' THEN (CASE WHEN OS_TYPE = 'B' THEN ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) As BonusAmt, Sum(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN (CASE WHEN OS_TYPE = 'A' THEN GOLD_WT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) as GlFine, Sum(CASE WHEN SIGN = '-' THEN (CASE WHEN OS_TYPE = 'D' THEN GOLD_WT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) as AdjFine FROM AD_OS WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND MEMB_CODE = ' ? ' AND MEMB_CODE = ' ? ' ? C ? And DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? HAVING (Sum(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN (CASE WHEN OS_TYPE = 'A' THEN ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) <> 0 or Sum(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN (CASE WHEN OS_TYPE = 'D' THEN ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) <> 0 OR Sum(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN (CASE WHEN OS_TYPE = 'B' THEN ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) <> 0)

SELECT A.* ,B.AC_NAME FROM AD_OS AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LD_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.MEMB_CODE = ' ? ' AND SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' ? C ? And A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,SCHM_DATE,A.CO_BOOK

SELECT UPI_TYPE,UPI_AMT,UPI_AC_NAME FROM UPI_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? CO_YEAR ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? CO_BOOK ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? VCH_NO ? ' AND SR_NO = ? SR_NO ?

SELECT A.BOOK_NAME As BookNameL,A.CO_BOOK As BookL FROM BOOK_DATA AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.BOOK_NAME
SELECT A.MEMB_CODE,A.MEMB_NAME,A.SCHM_CODE FROM AD_MEMB AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' ? And A.MEMB_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.MEMB_CODE as MembNoL,A.MEMB_NAME As MembNameL,A.AC_MOBILE AS MobileL,A.SCHM_CODE AS SchemeL ,A.MEMB_AMT AS SchmAmtR,FORMAT(SUM(IIF(SIGN = '+',B.ADJ_AMT,- B.ADJ_AMT)),'0.00') AS MembBalR FROM AD_MEMB AS A LEFT JOIN AD_OS AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE AND A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY A.MEMB_CODE,A.MEMB_NAME,A.SCHM_CODE,A.MEMB_AMT,A.AC_MOBILE ORDER BY A.SCHM_CODE,A.MEMB_CODE
